shopInventoryStatus: Unconfirmed for every new identity. Public supplier availability is independent of StackR stock.
shopPriceStatus: No fabricated market values or asking prices. Parent pricing service must supply sourced comparable values.
imageStatus: Only unchanged manufacturer or isolated supplier packshots shown. Fourteen original scene-photo silhouettes replaced or withdrawn; 10 of those products still await clean exact-unit artwork. Missing originals remain explicit. No upscaling, watermark removal or invented packaging.

sourceCoverage.name: Asmodee UK Pokémon catalogue
sourceCoverage.availability: Current trade catalogue, with publication dates reconciled through product pages. Public variants.available does not establish consumer stock.
sourceCoverage.limits: Existing retail identities retained; explicit future releases, missing dates, absent or unresolved counts, toys/accessories and conflicting titles/descriptions excluded.

sourceCoverage.name: Japan2UK Japanese booster-box catalogue
sourceCoverage.availability: Exact full sealed retail booster boxes observed offered in stock on source feed.
sourceCoverage.limits: Excludes no-shrink, damaged/opened/case/loose and unavailable items. Original Japanese identities retained. No clean artwork inferred from supplier candidate images.

sourceCoverage.name: Japan2UK Simplified Chinese booster-box catalogue
sourceCoverage.availability: Exact full sealed retail booster boxes observed offered in stock on source feed.
sourceCoverage.limits: Simplified Chinese only; Traditional Chinese product is a separate language/edition. Excludes unavailable, nonstandard condition and duplicate retail identities.

sourceCoverage.name: Japan2UK Korean booster-box catalogue
sourceCoverage.availability: Exact full sealed retail booster boxes observed offered in stock on source feed.
sourceCoverage.limits: Exact Korean printings only; no Japanese or English substitutes for imagery/cards.

completeness: A broad, bounded current supplier catalogue expansion. This is not a claim to include every Pokémon product globally; a continuously maintained supplier inventory feed is required for that.
stock: Owner stock is not inferred from supplier listings.
